w10_T4_000000: Priya had saved 126 dollars in a jar. Over the weekend she earned 8 dollars for raking leaves, found 3 dollars in an old coat, and received 32 dollars from her grandmother. At the bank she changed the entire jar into quarters, at 4 quarters to the dollar. At the arcade every quarter buys 9 tokens, and she fed all of her quarters into the machine. How many tokens did Priya get?
w10_T4_000001: Marcus started the week with 126 stickers. He gave half of them to his friend Leah. On Wednesday a trading event doubled the number of stickers Marcus had left. On Thursday he received 80 stickers from a new pack, and on Friday he handed 83 of his stickers to Leah, after which Leah had more stickers than Marcus. How many stickers does Marcus have now?
w10_T4_000003: A courier firm bills its clients by the minute. In the morning Dana drove 8 routes of 89 minutes each, and then the dispatcher struck 74 minutes of idling from the log. In the afternoon the second driver logged exactly as many minutes as the whole morning total, so the running total doubled. Before dinner the client disputed 906 minutes, which were removed from the bill. In the evening Dana drove for one more hour, which is 60 minutes, and that time was accepted. How many billable minutes did the firm record for the day?
w10_T4_000009: Coach Ruiz keeps a distance log for the swim club. At the start of the week the log showed 88 laps; the swimmers added 41 laps during the week and 8 more on Saturday. Each lap is 8 lengths of the pool, so the coach converted the whole lap total into lengths. The relay squad, which trains twice a week, then added 27 extra lengths on Sunday. For the league standings every length is worth 9 points, and the club was also awarded 70 bonus points for attendance. How many points does the club have in the standings?
w10_T4_000013: A farmer keeps 215 hens in each of his 5 barns. The barns were built 12 years ago. He sells 755 hens to a neighbour. Each of the remaining hens lays 2 eggs a day, and he collects the eggs for 2 days before the weekend market. At the market every egg sells for 7 pesos, and he also sells a sack of feathers for 80 pesos. How many pesos does the farmer take in at the market?
w10_T4_000014: At first 79 students signed up for the museum trip. Then 17 of them dropped out, and 61 students from another class joined. The trip is 45 kilometres each way. Every student going on the trip pays 6 dollars, and the bake sale added 49 dollars to the trip fund. How many dollars are in the trip fund?
w10_T4_000017: Omar keeps 58 bottle caps in each of his 5 jars. He gives 227 caps to a school art project. His friend Beth, who has gathered many more caps than Omar, gives him 33 of hers, though she still has more than he does. Omar then splits all his caps equally into 3 display boxes. Later he glues 75 extra caps onto the front box only. How many caps are on the front box now?
w10_T4_000020: A lemonade stand's tank held 46 gallons at opening, and the owners poured in 70 more gallons before the crowd arrived. They serve by the cup, so they worked out the volume in cups: there are 4 quarts in a gallon, and 4 cups in a quart. During the day they served 706 cups. How many cups of lemonade are left in the tank?
w10_T4_000025: Nina and Theo baked 156 cookies and spread them equally over 4 trays. Nina took one tray for herself, then found 3 more cookies on the counter and added them. Theo gave her 21 cookies from his tray, so Nina now had more cookies than Theo. She sold each of her cookies for 3 dollars at the fair and received a 25 dollar tip. How many dollars did Nina collect?
w10_T4_000028: Kofi has 232 stamps in his album. He gives 55 stamps to his cousin Ama, and even after that Kofi still has more stamps than Ama. The stamp fair, which runs for 4 days, values each of Kofi's stamps at 3 credits. Because of a promotion, the fair then doubles the credits he holds. Kofi spends 543 credits on a rare stamp. How many credits does Kofi have left?
w10_T4_000031: In the morning the florist had 34 yards of ribbon; since there are 3 feet in a yard, she recorded it in feet. She used 36 feet of ribbon on the morning bouquets. In the afternoon a delivery brought 29 feet, and a customer returned 64 feet unused. In the evening she found another 18 feet in a drawer. How many feet of ribbon does the florist have?
w10_T4_000043: In the morning 181 passengers were waiting at the ferry terminal, and 172 of them boarded the first ferry. The ferry can carry 200 passengers. In the afternoon 57 more passengers arrived, and then 25 of the waiting passengers left on a small boat. In the evening 5 more passengers arrived. How many passengers are waiting at the terminal at the end of the evening?
w10_T4_000048: A dairy had 94 pints of cream. It sold 40 pints to a bakery, and 6 pints spoiled and were thrown away. The rest was poured into quart bottles, with 2 pints filling each quart. The quart bottles were then packed into gallon crates, 4 quarts to a gallon. How many gallons of cream does the dairy have?
w10_T4_000056: In the morning the bakery made 5 batches of 231 bread rolls, and there were 39 rolls left over from the day before. In the afternoon a cafe bought 522 rolls, and walk-in customers bought 276 rolls. In the evening the baker cut each remaining roll into 3 pieces for croutons. There were already 51 pieces bagged from earlier. How many crouton pieces does the bakery have?
w10_T4_000057: In the morning Grandpa gave 150 dollars to be split equally among his 5 grandchildren, and Lily took her share straight to the bank, where she changed all of it into quarters at 4 quarters to the dollar. The arcade is 3 blocks from her house. In the afternoon she spent half of her quarters at the arcade. In the evening she found 18 more quarters in her coat pocket. How many quarters does Lily have?
w10_T4_000061: A charity run had 206 registered runners. Then 68 more registered online, 25 signed up at the school, 61 joined through a company team, and 10 registered on the morning of the race. A dozen volunteers handed out water along the 21 kilometre route. The organizers divided all the runners equally into 5 starting waves. How many runners are in the first wave?
w10_T4_000063: In the morning the busker's guitar case held 126 cents. He keeps his tally in cents and never bothers converting it into dollars. A passer-by dropped in 16 cents and a family added 58 cents before noon. In the afternoon he collected 38 cents. In the evening a late listener gave 14 cents. How many cents did the busker have at the end of the day?
w10_T4_000065: In the morning Rosa's market stall had 58 pints of strawberries, and a farmer delivered 43 more pints. In the afternoon 11 pints spoiled in the heat and 72 pints were sold. Her neighbour Luis sold fewer pints of strawberries than Rosa did that day. In the evening Rosa repacked her remaining strawberries into cups, with 2 cups to a pint. How many cups of strawberries does Rosa have?
w10_T4_000077: Jonas stacks 48 bricks on each tray, 4 trays on each rack, and fills 9 racks. His kiln runs at 900 degrees. He sells 1450 bricks to Marta, who now owns more bricks than Jonas has left. Each of Jonas's remaining bricks is cut into 4 pavers, and each paver sells for 8 rupees. How many rupees does Jonas make from the pavers?
w10_T4_000080: Aunt Mei gave Wen 184 dollars. Wen spent 118 dollars on a coat that came with 3 wooden buttons. She changed the rest of the money into quarters, at 4 quarters to the dollar, and then swapped every quarter for nickels, 5 nickels to a quarter, for a coin-sorting game. She gave half of the nickels to her cousin. How many nickels does Wen keep?
w10_T4_000088: In the morning the ship's chandler had 26 fathoms of rope; a fathom is 6 feet, so he measured his stock in feet. In the afternoon a delivery added 67 feet of rope. In the evening he sold all of the rope at 6 dollars per foot and also sold a brass hook for 58 dollars. How many dollars did the chandler take in?
w10_T4_000090: A plant nursery has 179 seed trays. Each tray has 3 rows, each row has 3 cells, and each cell is sown with 3 seeds. Once sown, the seeds are divided equally among the nursery's 3 greenhouses. How many seeds go into the north greenhouse?
w10_T4_000097: In the morning the cider press produced 193 gallons of cider, which the crew recorded in quarts because there are 4 quarts in a gallon. Right away 717 quarts were sold to a distributor. In the afternoon 15 quarts came back from a cancelled order, and 27 quarts spoiled. In the evening each remaining quart was bottled into 6 small bottles, and 80 small bottles were left from last week. How many small bottles does the press have?
w10_T4_000103: The choir sold 35 concert tickets on the first day, 26 on the second, and 61 on the third. Each ticket cost 9 dollars. A sponsor agreed to triple whatever amount the choir raised from tickets. Afterwards 18 dollars in loose donations were added. The whole sum was then shared equally among 3 charities. How many dollars does the animal shelter charity receive?
w10_T4_000104: Leo had 36 coins in the game. A power-up doubled his coins. He spent 52 coins on a shield, then found 30 coins in a treasure chest. He lost 3 coins falling into a river and won 53 coins in the final race. How many coins does Leo have?
